# Dutch Grand Prix Preview

Max Verstappen hunts another dominant display at his home circuit as Red Bull seeks to extend its championship stranglehold against a resurgent McLaren challenge. The midfield reshuffles dramatically with Hadjar sidelined by injury, opening unexpected opportunities for reserve drivers while Haas and Cadillac navigate their ongoing structural upheaval. Victory here could prove pivotal—this marks Zandvoort's final F1 race, making any breakthrough performance a historic footnote in the championship fight's closing stretch.
